command_tasks.name: dir
command_tasks.note:
List files and folders in the current directory
/w Wide list format
/a Show hidden files
/s Recursive subdirectories

command_tasks.name: tree
command_tasks.note:
Display directory structure in tree format
/f Include file names
/a Use ASCII characters

command_tasks.name: cd and list
command_tasks.note:
Switch to the specified directory and list its contents
cd /d supports switching across drives

command_tasks.name: Search Files
command_tasks.note:
Recursively search for files matching the pattern
/s Search subdirectories, /b Bare format (full path only)
Example: dir /s /b *.txt

command_tasks.name: Disk Space
command_tasks.note: List total and free space for all disk partitions

command_tasks.name: copy
command_tasks.note:
Copy file to destination
/y Suppress overwrite prompt
/-y Prompt before overwrite

command_tasks.name: move
command_tasks.note: Move file to a new location

command_tasks.name: del
command_tasks.note:
Delete specified file
/f Force delete read-only files
/q Quiet mode (no confirmation)

command_tasks.name: mkdir
command_tasks.note:
Create a new directory at the current path
Supports relative and absolute paths

command_tasks.name: ren Batch Rename
command_tasks.note:
Batch rename file extensions in current directory
Example: change .txt to .log

command_tasks.name: fc File Compare
command_tasks.note:
Compare two files and display differences
/b Binary compare
/i Ignore case

command_tasks.name: tar Compress
command_tasks.note:
Compress directory into tar.gz archive
Built-in tar command on Windows 10+

command_tasks.name: type View File
command_tasks.note:
Display full content of a file in terminal
Equivalent to cat on Linux

command_tasks.name: findstr Search Content
command_tasks.note:
Search for specific text within files
/s Search subdirectories
/i Case-insensitive

command_tasks.name: systeminfo
command_tasks.note:
Display detailed system configuration
Includes OS version, hardware info, network, etc.

command_tasks.name: tasklist
command_tasks.note:
List all currently running processes
Use /fi to filter by name

command_tasks.name: taskkill
command_tasks.note:
Terminate specified process
/im By process name
/pid By process ID
/f Force termination

command_tasks.name: Check Port Usage
command_tasks.note:
Check port usage and corresponding process PID
Common ports: 80(http) 443(https) 3306(mysql)

command_tasks.name: set Env Vars
command_tasks.note:
View all environment variables or a specific one
No arguments lists all variables

command_tasks.name: shutdown
command_tasks.note:
Control computer power state
/s Shutdown
/r Restart
/a Abort
/t Delay in seconds (0=immediate)

command_tasks.name: ping
command_tasks.note:
Test network connectivity
-n Specify count
-t Ping continuously until stopped

command_tasks.name: nslookup
command_tasks.note: Query IP address and DNS info for a domain

command_tasks.name: tracert
command_tasks.note:
Trace the route packets take to reach a target
Useful for diagnosing latency and connection issues

command_tasks.name: ipconfig
command_tasks.note:
View or manage network adapter settings
/all Show full details
/release Release IP
/renew Renew IP

command_tasks.name: Flush DNS Cache
command_tasks.note:
Clear local DNS cache
Fixes DNS resolution issues or stale domain entries

command_tasks.name: python http.server
command_tasks.note:
Start a simple HTTP server in the current directory
Common ports: 8080, 8888, 9000
Blocking mode, runs in background

command_tasks.name: git status
command_tasks.note:
Show current status of the Git repository
-s Short output showing modified/new/deleted files

command_tasks.name: git log
command_tasks.note:
View Git commit history
--oneline One line per commit
-10 Last 10 commits
--graph Visual branch graph

command_tasks.name: npm install
command_tasks.note:
Install project dependencies from package.json
--save-dev Install dev dependencies
--production Install production deps only

command_tasks.name: python venv
command_tasks.note:
Create and activate a Python virtual environment
Common names: venv, env, .venv
